'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBT rights in Singapore]]
**The [[Parliament of Singapore]] repeals [[Section 377A (Singapore)|Section 377A]], thereby decriminalising [[Men who have sex with men|sex between consenting male adults]] in [[Singapore|the country]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/08/21/world/asia/singapore-gay-sex-law.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[November 2021 English Channel disaster]]
**The [[Gloucestershire Constabulary]] arrest a man near [[Cheltenham]], [[Cotswolds]], [[England]], as a [[prime suspect]] in [[Criminal conspiracy|conspiring]] to transport 30 [[Illegal immigration to the United Kingdom|illegal immigrants]] from [[France]] to the United Kingdom on an [[inflatable boat]], of which all but three died when the boat capsized in transit along the [[English Channel]] in 2021. [https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/world/2022-11-29-uk-police-arrest-man-over-2021-deaths-of-27-migrants/ (AFP via ''The Star'')]
